assumption.description: One dominant claim to test: Runtime provenance can significantly impact the efficiency and scalability of local LLM operations.

inversion.description: The opposite claim would be that while runtime provenance is important, it should not replace other key performance metrics such as resource utilization or dataset size.

predictions.description: 1. The time taken for a local LLM to process a given task.
2. The number of operations executed per second (operations per minute) by the local LLM.
3. The consistency or reliability of runtime provenance across multiple runs and datasets.

result.title: runtime provenance for local LLMs
